Scope (nothing dropped):
- /home/user/probes/web-todo/.autodev/mission.json holds the original request word for word and requirements R1-R5. The architecture repeats them verbatim and states that it does not narrow any of them.
- backlog.json (schema v2) has T1-T6, all PASS, all with execution run1/root1. Each of R1-R5 maps to its own task (T1-T5), and T6 covers R1-R5 together.
- contract.json (v2) has 23 checks. Every requirement has test, behavior and visual checks, and there are build checks (T1-build, T6-build). The 19 inherited checks were kept and 4 were added. No check or requirement was removed.

Evidence at the current product, contract and identity:
- There is one runner record for each of the 23 checks. All have exit_code 0, stable true and report_error null.
- Each linked .report.json contains only PASS assertions (1042 in total, no FAIL, UNVERIFIED or BLOCKED).
- Browser checks ran in real Chromium 153.0.8010.12 through Playwright 1.64.1. The binary came from AUTODEV_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=/opt/pw-browsers/chromium.
- The behaviour checks type with keyboard.type, press Enter, click or tap Add, the checkboxes, delete buttons and filters, and do a real page.reload.
- T4-visual includes the three negative controls added when the pixel-comparison tolerance was changed, and all three pass. So the tolerance still catches real changes and R4 is not weakened.
- T6-test has 20 assertions on zero console errors and no horizontal scroll, across both viewports.

- Plain HTML, CSS and JS with no build step and no packages.
- Input is trimmed and empty or whitespace-only input is ignored. Enter and the Add button both go through the form submit.
- The checkbox toggles li.done, which gets a line-through and a muted colour. The delete button has an aria-label.
- The three filter buttons use aria-pressed and have a distinct selected style. The counter shows the number of active tasks across all tasks.
- Tasks are saved in localStorage under todo-app.v1. Loading normalises the data and rewrites it, and all storage access is wrapped in try/catch.
- Text is set with textContent. The page has a device-width viewport meta tag and the data: icon link, so there is no favicon 404.

Escalation counts only failures whose category is outside the external set, and 'evidence' is in that set. So this event does not move T2 toward a Sonnet or Opus repair round. The finding carried over from the milestone audits is explained and needs no action on the product.
